package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func planningSnapshotID(n int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d", n) }
func planningSnapshotFixture() (PlanningSnapshotSource, PlanningSnapshotRequest) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	sid, pid := planningSnapshotID(1), planningSnapshotID(2)
	targets := []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}, {Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}
	theory := LessonRequirement{ID: planningSnapshotID(5), ActivityID: planningSnapshotID(6), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, Satisfied: true, SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: planningSnapshotID(4)}}
	quiz := LessonRequirement{ID: planningSnapshotID(10), ActivityID: planningSnapshotID(11), Type: "quiz_passed", Required: true, SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: planningSnapshotID(12), RevisionID: planningSnapshotID(13)}}
	practice := LessonRequirement{ID: planningSnapshotID(14), ActivityID: planningSnapshotID(15), Type: "practice_completed", Required: true, SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: planningSnapshotID(16), RevisionID: planningSnapshotID(16)}}
	source := PlanningSnapshotSource{StudentID: sid, RequestedTargets: targets, CapturedAt: now,
		Profile: StudentOnboarding{StudentID: sid, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", KnownStacks: []string{"sql", "go"}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job", GoalText: "PRIVATE_GOAL_CANARY", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced", ProfileVersion: StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: 3, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now},
		Path: StudentLearningPath{ID: pid, StudentID: sid, CourseID: planningSnapshotID(3), GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "old-course-fingerprint", CourseFingerprint: "old-course-fingerprint", PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "PRIVATE_REASON_CANARY", Status: LearningPathStatusActive, IsPrimary: true, Version: 7, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []LearningPathItem{
			{ID: planningSnapshotID(7), LessonRevisionID: planningSnapshotID(8), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: planningSnapshotID(4), Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemCompleted, Targets: targets, ReasonCode: "lesson_requirements_satisfied", FrozenRequirements: []LessonRequirement{theory}, LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"PRIVATE_LESSON_CANARY","answer":"PRIVATE_ANSWER_CANARY","workspace":"PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_CANARY"}`)},
			{ID: planningSnapshotID(9), LessonRevisionID: planningSnapshotID(17), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: planningSnapshotID(18), Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemInProgress, Targets: targets, ReasonCode: "lesson_activity_satisfied", FrozenRequirements: []LessonRequirement{quiz, practice}},
		}},
		Context:          StudentLearningContext{Schema: LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: sid, SelectedLearningPathID: pid, Version: 11, UpdatedAt: &now},
		Mastery:          []StudentTargetMastery{{StudentID: sid, Target: targets[1], State: TargetMasteryApplied, MasteryScore: 1, Confidence: 0.33333, IndependentSuccessCount: 1, EvidenceCount: 1, LastSeenAt: now, PolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion}},
		Evidence:         []PlanningEvidenceReference{{StudentID: sid, SourceKind: "course_answer", EvidenceID: planningSnapshotID(19), LearningActionID: planningSnapshotID(19), TaskID: planningSnapshotID(20), Target: targets[1], EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication, Outcome: LearningActionPassed, SupportContext: TeacherSupportIndependent, Kind: EvidenceIndependentApplication, TeacherPolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion, OccurredAt: now}},
		ActivityFacts:    []LessonActivityFact{{StudentID: sid, ItemID: planningSnapshotID(7), RequirementID: theory.ID, Type: theory.Type, SourceID: theory.SourceReference.ID, FactID: planningSnapshotID(21), OccurredAt: now}},
		CourseBindings:   []PlanningCourseActionBinding{{StudentID: sid, LearningActionID: planningSnapshotID(22), AnswerID: planningSnapshotID(23), TaskID: quiz.SourceReference.ID, LearningPathItemID: planningSnapshotID(9), RequirementID: quiz.ID, LifecycleStatus: "OPEN", AnswerStatus: StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview, LearningTargets: targets, OpenedAt: now}},
		PracticeBindings: []PracticeLearningActionBinding{{Schema: StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema, LearningActionID: planningSnapshotID(24), StudentID: sid, TaskInstanceID: planningSnapshotID(25), TaskRevisionID: practice.SourceReference.ID, TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: targets, LifecycleStatus: PracticeLearningActionOpen, LearningPathID: pid, LearningPathItemID: planningSnapshotID(9), RequirementID: practice.ID, LearningPathVersionReservation: 7, LearningPathPositionReservation: 1, OpenedAt: &now}},
	}
	return source, PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "teacher_request", Reason: "manual caller trace", CorrelationID: planningSnapshotID(26)}}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotWhitelistsPrivateSourcesAndKeepsProtectedOccurrences(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	rawBefore, _ := json.Marshal(source)
	privateBefore := string(source.Path.Items[0].LessonContent)
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"PRIVATE_GOAL_CANARY", "PRIVATE_REASON_CANARY", "PRIVATE_LESSON_CANARY", "PRIVATE_ANSWER_CANARY", "PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_CANARY", "goal_text", "reason_summary", "lesson_content", "expected_answers", "workspace"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(raw), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("private input escaped whitelist: %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
	for i, item := range source.Path.Items {
		got := result.Path.Items[i]
		if got.ID != item.ID || got.Status != item.Status || got.LessonRevisionID != item.LessonRevisionID || !reflect.DeepEqual(got.FrozenRequirements, item.FrozenRequirements) {
			t.Fatalf("protected occurrence changed: source=%#v result=%#v", item, got)
		}
	}
	if result.PracticeBindings[0].TaskInstanceID != source.PracticeBindings[0].TaskInstanceID || result.PracticeBindings[0].RequirementID != source.PracticeBindings[0].RequirementID || result.CourseBindings[0].AnswerID != source.CourseBindings[0].AnswerID {
		t.Fatal("local execution association lost")
	}
	if result.Profile.GoalCode == result.Path.GoalCode {
		t.Fatal("current global goal was overwritten by historical exact path goal")
	}
	if len(result.Mastery) != 2 || result.Mastery[0].State != TargetMasteryApplied || result.Mastery[1].State != TargetMasteryUnknown || result.Mastery[1].EvidenceCount != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("missing row semantics: %#v", result.Mastery)
	}
	for _, signal := range []PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{result.Availability.RuntimeHold, result.Availability.AutomaticAdaptation, result.Availability.StudentPinning} {
		if signal.Status != "UNAVAILABLE" || signal.Value != nil || signal.ReasonCode == "" {
			t.Fatalf("absent capability became permissive default: %#v", signal)
		}
	}
	rawAfter, _ := json.Marshal(source)
	if string(rawBefore) != string(rawAfter) || privateBefore != string(source.Path.Items[0].LessonContent) {
		t.Fatal("read-only builder mutated source")
	}
	var roundtrip StudentPlanningSnapshot
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &roundtrip) != nil {
		t.Fatal("response decode")
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(roundtrip); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("typed wire roundtrip rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRefsAreCanonicalAndExcludeCaptureTraceCosmeticTimes(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	first, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source.CapturedAt = source.CapturedAt.Add(time.Hour)
	source.Profile.UpdatedAt = source.CapturedAt
	source.Path.UpdatedAt = source.CapturedAt
	source.Context.UpdatedAt = &source.CapturedAt
	source.Profile.KnownStacks = []string{"go", "sql"}
	source.Path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0], source.Path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[1] = source.Path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[1], source.Path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0]
	request.Targets = []LearningTargetRef{request.Targets[1], request.Targets[0]}
	source.RequestedTargets = request.Targets
	request.TriggerContext = PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "student_request", Reason: "different manual trace"}
	second, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.References != second.References {
		t.Fatalf("same applicability changed refs: first=%#v second=%#v", first.References, second.References)
	}
	if second.CapturedAt.Equal(first.CapturedAt) || second.TriggerContext == first.TriggerContext {
		t.Fatal("trace/capture provenance was discarded")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRefsCoverApplicableOwnerState(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"profile_version", "goal", "constraints", "path_version", "journey_version", "satisfaction", "task_instance", "course_answer", "fact", "mastery", "evidence_receipt", "target_set"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
			original, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			switch name {
			case "profile_version":
				source.Profile.Version++
			case "goal":
				source.Profile.GoalCode = "backend-job"
				source.Profile.Version++
			case "constraints":
				source.Profile.WeeklyMinutes = 600
				source.Profile.Version++
			case "path_version":
				source.Path.Version++
			case "journey_version":
				source.Context.Version++
			case "satisfaction":
				source.Path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
			case "task_instance":
				source.PracticeBindings[0].TaskInstanceID = planningSnapshotID(100)
			case "course_answer":
				source.CourseBindings[0].AnswerStatus = StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress
			case "fact":
				source.ActivityFacts[0].FactID = planningSnapshotID(101)
			case "mastery":
				source.Mastery[0].Confidence = 0.5
			case "evidence_receipt":
				source.Evidence = append(source.Evidence, PlanningEvidenceReference{StudentID: source.StudentID, SourceKind: "practice_legacy", EvidenceID: planningSnapshotID(102), TaskInstanceID: planningSnapshotID(103), TaskRevisionID: planningSnapshotID(104), SubmissionID: planningSnapshotID(102), Target: request.Targets[0], EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication, Outcome: LearningActionPassed, SupportContext: TeacherSupportIndependent, Kind: EvidenceIndependentApplication, TeacherPolicyVersion: "practice-v1", MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion, ReceiptHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), OccurredAt: source.CapturedAt})
			case "target_set":
				target := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "legacy.opaque"}
				request.Targets = append(request.Targets, target)
				source.RequestedTargets = request.Targets
			}
			next, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if next.References.SnapshotRef == original.References.SnapshotRef {
				t.Fatalf("%s absent from applicability digest", name)
			}
			if name == "mastery" || name == "evidence_receipt" || name == "target_set" {
				if next.References.MasteryRef == original.References.MasteryRef {
					t.Fatal("relevant knowledge input omitted")
				}
			} else if next.References.LearnerRef == original.References.LearnerRef {
				t.Fatal("relevant learner state omitted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRejectsMalformedOwnershipBindingsAndTamperedResponses(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"source_student", "profile_student", "context_student", "mastery_student", "evidence_student", "missing_context", "missing_item_id", "dangling_course", "wrong_course_task", "dangling_practice", "wrong_practice_revision", "duplicate_evidence", "foreign_target", "duplicate_mastery", "nan_mastery"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
			switch name {
			case "source_student":
				source.StudentID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "profile_student":
				source.Profile.StudentID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "context_student":
				source.Context.StudentID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "mastery_student":
				source.Mastery[0].StudentID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "evidence_student":
				source.Evidence[0].StudentID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "missing_context":
				source.Context = StudentLearningContext{}
			case "missing_item_id":
				source.Path.Items[0].ID = ""
			case "dangling_course":
				source.CourseBindings[0].LearningPathItemID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "wrong_course_task":
				source.CourseBindings[0].TaskID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "dangling_practice":
				source.PracticeBindings[0].RequirementID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "wrong_practice_revision":
				source.PracticeBindings[0].TaskRevisionID = planningSnapshotID(200)
			case "duplicate_evidence":
				source.Evidence = append(source.Evidence, source.Evidence[0])
			case "foreign_target":
				source.Evidence[0].Target.Key = "another-target"
			case "duplicate_mastery":
				source.Mastery = append(source.Mastery, source.Mastery[0])
			case "nan_mastery":
				source.Mastery[0].Confidence = math.NaN()
			}
			if _, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed source accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result.Path.Items[0].Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(result); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("tampered protected state retained old applicability ref")
	}
	result, err = BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result.Availability.AutomaticAdaptation.Value = &struct{}{}
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(result); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unsupported permission populated")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRequestSupportsWholeGraphAndExactLegacyIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	targets := make([]LearningTargetRef, 500)
	for i := range targets {
		targets[i] = LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: fmt.Sprintf("%03d%s", i, strings.Repeat("x", 252)), Version: strings.Repeat("v", 128)}
	}
	request := PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "arbitrary caller trace", Reason: "arbitrary reason"}}
	if got, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request); err != nil || len(got.Targets) != 500 {
		t.Fatalf("existing whole graph vocabulary rejected: %v", err)
	}
	request.Targets = []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "legacy"}}
	got, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request)
	if err != nil || got.Targets[0].Version != "" {
		t.Fatalf("exact legacy empty version changed: %v", err)
	}
	request.Targets = append(request.Targets, request.Targets[0])
	if _, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate exact targets accepted")
	}
	request.Targets = targets
	request.TriggerContext.Reason = strings.Repeat("x", MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes)
	if _, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("technical payload overflow accepted")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotPreservesExistingMaximumRequirementVocabulary(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	item := &source.Path.Items[0]
	item.FrozenRequirements = make([]LessonRequirement, 500)
	for i := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		item.FrozenRequirements[i] = LessonRequirement{ID: planningSnapshotID(1000 + i), ActivityID: planningSnapshotID(2000 + i), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, Satisfied: true, SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: item.ReferenceID}}
	}
	source.ActivityFacts = nil
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil || len(result.Path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements) != 500 {
		t.Fatalf("valid frozen requirement envelope truncated/rejected: %v", err)
	}
	requirementBytes, _ := json.Marshal(item.FrozenRequirements[0])
	// The byte budget accommodates the existing 500-by-500 route envelope;
	// it is not a new semantic item/requirement/evidence-count policy.
	if 500*500*len(requirementBytes) >= MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		t.Fatal("technical budget contradicts existing maximum route vocabulary")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotHybridPolicyAvailabilityOwnedByPlanner(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, signal := range []PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{result.Availability.EvidenceQuality, result.Availability.Stability} {
		if signal.Status != "DERIVED_BY_PLANNER" || signal.Value != nil || signal.ReasonCode != "PLANNER_POLICY_HYBRID_V1" {
			t.Fatalf("accepted Hybrid policy projection must name Planner owner: %#v", signal)
		}
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotFrozenPracticeSurfaceAndUnknownProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	for _, surface := range []string{"practice", "project", ""} {
		t.Run(surface, func(t *testing.T) {
			source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
			source.Evidence = append(source.Evidence, PlanningEvidenceReference{
				StudentID: source.StudentID, SourceKind: "practice_v2", SurfaceClassification: surface,
				EvidenceID: planningSnapshotID(201), LearningActionID: planningSnapshotID(202),
				TaskInstanceID: planningSnapshotID(203), TaskRevisionID: planningSnapshotID(204), SubmissionID: planningSnapshotID(201),
				Target: request.Targets[0], EvidenceClass: LearningEvidenceApplication, Outcome: LearningActionPassed,
				SupportContext: TeacherSupportIndependent, Kind: EvidenceIndependentApplication,
				TeacherPolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion,
				ReceiptHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), OccurredAt: source.CapturedAt,
			})
			result, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var got PlanningEvidenceReference
			for _, item := range result.Evidence {
				if item.SourceKind == "practice_v2" {
					got = item
				}
			}
			if got.SurfaceClassification != surface || got.TaskInstanceID != planningSnapshotID(203) || got.Kind != EvidenceIndependentApplication {
				t.Fatal("frozen surface/independence/source identity lost or inferred")
			}
			originalRef := result.References.SnapshotRef
			source.Evidence[1].SurfaceClassification = "invalid-provider-text"
			if _, err = BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed surface accepted")
			}
			if surface != "project" {
				source.Evidence[1].SurfaceClassification = "project"
				next, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
				if err != nil || next.References.SnapshotRef == originalRef {
					t.Fatal("surface omitted from applicability")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	source.Evidence[0].SurfaceClassification = "project"
	if _, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Course provenance gained fabricated Practice surface")
	}
	source.Evidence[0].SurfaceClassification = ""
	source.Evidence[0].SourceKind = "unknown-provider"
	if _, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed discriminator accepted")
	}
}
